content:
liz_support: Customer (acct=jb-enterprises) opened a ticket — after a failover policy edit they started getting 401s and a sharp latency/egress bill increase. They say traffic is landing in us-east even though org is pinned to eu-west.
raj_engineering: Can you paste the org id + sample request id? also any recent policy edits?
liz_support: org=jb-ent-42, example request id=req_8f7c9a, edit was a UI change to failover weights at ~2032104200.
sasha_sre: Pulling routing logs now. two immediate things to check: control-plane policy representation and whether sticky session keys (cookie/ip) were remapped.
tim_oncall: Deploy bot shows a UI patch rolled at 2032104187 with description "failover ui: weight input sanitization" — deploy-bot: roll/1234 succeeded :white_check_mark:.
raj_engineering: can we get the stored policy from the CP for that org? asking for JSON snapshot.
liz_support: pasted snapshot from control plane: ```{"priority":["eu-west","us-east"],"weights":{"eu-west":"0.75","us-east":"0.25"},"sticky":true}```
sasha_sre: interesting — weights are strings not numbers. looking at router logs: the policy parser coerced weights to integers, truncating decimals -> eu-west weight became 0, us-east became 0 too, fallback logic then used priority order fallback which was inverted by an earlier sort bug. result: many sessions fell through to default region (us-east).
raj_engineering: repro steps I used: set org policy with decimal weights via API, then hit endpoint with X-Org-ID: jb-ent-42 repeatedly — observe 401s after KV cache miss. curl example: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-***" -H "X-Org-ID: jb-ent-42" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'```
liz_support: customer saw 401s when their key was routed to a region where their key wasn't provisioned — that matches. billing team flagged egress because cross-region hops increased.
raj_engineering: root cause summary: UI change to weight input started saving weights as strings; downstream parser assumed numeric and did Math.floor/truncation; combined with a priority-sort edge case produced inverted effective priorities for sticky sessions.
sasha_sre: mitigation applied: patched router to treat weight strings safely (parseFloat fallback) and added a temporary override to honor explicit org-region binding for jb-ent-42. also rolled a hotfix to the control-plane policy validation to reject non-numeric weight types.
raj_engineering: follow-ups: 1) data migration to convert existing stored weight strings to floats 2) add unit + e2e tests for sticky routing with decimal weights 3) UI validation to prevent strings getting stored 4) postmortem and customer credit.
liz_support: I'll tell the customer we've applied a fix and added an override; offering a billing credit and internal RCA when done. thanks team. :thumbsup: :eyes:
tim_oncall: logging ticket filed (INVEST-3247) for migration + tests. leaving this thread open until migration completes.
sasha_sre: Pushed migration plan to ops; estimate 2-3 hours safety window. will update.
liz_support: closing loop with customer now, will update once they confirm 401s stop.
